description: What the search covered and what is still open, in the report's own words — each area with its state (Searched — clean / Partially covered / Open item / Not run this run). An area that is not clean is NOT cleared: read it as open. Reach for this whenever a result looks clean and the user is about to rely on it.

runId.description: The run's full runId (slug-date-codename) OR just its codename.
